snippet.title: MindFall - Official Teaser Gameplay
snippet.description:
MindFall is a psychological horror game currently in development.

This teaser contains gameplay footage captured from an early development build and showcases the game's atmosphere, environments, and visual style.

Status: Pre-Alpha Development
